kind: sanitized deterministic baseline reproduction, not independent audit
baseline_source: git archive for first rerun; clean detached Git checkout for public-launcher validation
probe_adaptation: Only source selection/import bootstrap changed. Public copies take an explicit checkout argument, verify exact baseline HEAD and a clean worktree before loading the unchanged model. Schedules, assertions and fault assumptions are unchanged.
zero_exit_meaning: Probe execution completed. R1 explicitly asserts the stall/control; R2/R3 final outcomes are printed observations, not complete outcome assertions. None is a pass of the desired repaired invariants.
scope_limits: synthetic identities, authentication, fixed membership and anchors
R1 real process kill/reopen; R2 and R3 same-process disk simulator
checker safety success is not liveness or resource-bound proof
temporary stores cleaned by original probes; bounded stdout retained, not a full per-event runtime stream
not machine-power-loss, production signer recovery, or deployment qualification
